name: android-emulator
description: Runs the Android emulator in the Claude desktop app: /emulator opens its live view in the browser pane, one Start button boots it

idleShutdownMinutes.title: Shut down an unused emulator after (minutes)
idleShutdownMinutes.description: An emulator started from the live view shuts down once no Claude session has shown it for this long; 0 keeps it running
